industry: Memory Semiconductors (DRAM / NAND / HBM) — the AI memory supercycle
selection_method: Active-conviction holdings: two single-name memory positions held and winning (MU +238% YTD, SNDK +571% YTD) plus AI-adjacent NVDA, making memory the account's clearest coherent industry bet.

items.label: Memory market
items.detail: IDC sees 2026 DRAM/NAND supply growth of only 16%/17% YoY vs demand from AI, and TrendForce/Jefferies model server-DRAM +60-70% QoQ with relief unlikely before 2027-2028 — an oligopoly (Samsung/SK Hynix/Micron ~95% of DRAM) with disciplined pricing.

items.label: RMBS
items.detail: Rambus is the single most asymmetric name: a DDR5/HBM interface-IP and register/PMIC content beneficiary that is FLAT YTD (-0.5%) and sits near its 52-week low ($91 vs $71 low / $174 high) while the whole sector is parabolic.

items.label: 042700.KS (Hanmi)
items.detail: Hanmi Semiconductor holds a near-monopoly on HBM thermal-compression bonders and each HBM4/HBM4E generation adds bonding steps (structural content growth); +68% YTD but ~43% off its high — a pullback in a picks-and-shovels winner (KRX access/liquidity is the catch).

items.label: 000660.KS (SK Hynix)
items.detail: SK Hynix is the HBM share leader (~62% of HBM shipments, UBS sees ~70% HBM4 share) yet up only 166% YTD — far less extended than SNDK/MU/Kioxia relative to its dominance.

items.label: LRCX
items.detail: Lam Research is the etch/deposition WFE leader most levered to 3D-NAND layer scaling and HBM TSV/DRAM capacity adds; +84% YTD with a durable equipment-oligopoly moat and higher visibility than the memory makers themselves.

items.label: CXL memory pooling
items.detail: Emerging market gap: as scarcity forces AI datacenters to pool and disaggregate memory, CXL expansion/controller vendors (Astera Labs, Marvell, Rambus) gain a new content vector that is barely priced in.

items.label: Cycle risk
items.detail: Parabolic moves in the pure memory makers (SNDK +571%, Kioxia +416% YTD) signal late-cycle froth, and 2026 capacity additions plus subsidized China supply (CXMT DRAM, YMTC NAND) could sharply reverse commodity-tier pricing.
